tbesh_html:
1) to murder, slay, kill
1a)(Qal) to murder, slay
1a1) premeditated
1a2) accidental
1a3) as avenger
1a4) slayer (intentional) (participle)
1b) (Niphal) to be slain
1c) (Piel)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to dash in pieces, i.e. kill (a human being), especially to murder
strongs_1890.kjv_def: put to death, kill, (man-) slay(-er), murder(-er).
